question: The Defence Ministry’s planned order for 500 Invar anti-tank guided missiles—valued at ₹2,000–3,000 crore—will be placed with which defence Public Sector Unit (PSU)?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bharat Dynamics Limited**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Bharat Dynamics Limited (BDL)** is a Public Sector Undertaking (PSU) under the administrative control of the Ministry of Defence, Government of India.
 
• The **Defence Ministry** plans to place an order for **500 Invar Anti-Tank Guided Missiles**, valued at ₹2,000–3,000 crore, with BDL.
 
• **Invar missiles** are fired from the **T-90 tanks** and are designed for destroying enemy tanks equipped with explosive reactive armour.
 
• BDL is the designated manufacturer for **Invar missiles** under a licensed technology transfer agreement with the original equipment manufacturer.
 
• BDL is headquartered in **Hyderabad, Telangana**, and is a leading manufacturer of missiles in India.
